<style>
html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

#left-box {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;

  width: 170px;
  height: calc(100vh - 100px);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2c3e50 0%, #34495e 100%);
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

  justify-content: flex-start;
  padding-top: 0px;
  z-index: 100;
  box-shadow: 4px 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);

  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

#left-box::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

#page-label {
  width: 100px;
  height: 35px;

  margin: 15px 10px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;

}

.sidebar-button {
  width: 150px;
  height: 35px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a5568 0%, #2d3748 100%);
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 3px 10px;
  display: flex;

.sidebar-button::before {

.sidebar-button:hover {

.page-button {

#scene-area {

#file-sliding-menu.open {

.file-menu-item {

#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.1s; }

#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(9) { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(10) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

</style>

<script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/fabric.js/5.3.0/fabric.min.js"></script>

<script>
// Basic variables for UI state
let isFileMenuOpen = false;
let currentPage = 1;
let totalPages = 1;
let pages = { 1: { objects: [] } };
let inPreviewMode = false;
let fabricCanvas = null;

// Initialize Fabric.js Canvas
function initializeFabricCanvas() {
  const container = document.getElementById('fabric-canvas-container');
  const canvasElement = document.getElementById('fabric-canvas');
  
  fabricCanvas = new fabric.Canvas('fabric-canvas', {
    width: container.clientWidth,
    height: container.clientHeight,
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    selection: true,
    preserveObjectStacking: true,
    renderOnAddRemove: true,
    enableRetinaScaling: true,
    imageSmoothingEnabled: true
  });

  // Enable zoom with mouse wheel
  fabricCanvas.on('mouse:wheel', function(opt) {
    var delta = opt.e.deltaY;
    var zoom = fabricCanvas.getZoom();
    zoom *= 0.999 ** delta;
    if (zoom > 20) zoom = 20;
    if (zoom < 0.01) zoom = 0.01;
    fabricCanvas.zoomToPoint({ x: opt.e.offsetX, y: opt.e.offsetY }, zoom);
    opt.e.preventDefault();
    opt.e.stopPropagation();
  });

  // Enable panning with middle mouse button or right click
  let isDragging = false;
  let lastPosX = 0;
  let lastPosY = 0;

  fabricCanvas.on('mouse:down', function(opt) {
    var evt = opt.e;
    if (evt.button === 1 || (evt.button === 2 && !fabricCanvas.getActiveObject())) { // Middle click or right click on empty space
      isDragging = true;
      fabricCanvas.selection = false;
      lastPosX = evt.clientX;
      lastPosY = evt.clientY;
      fabricCanvas.setCursor('grab');
    }
  });

  fabricCanvas.on('mouse:move', function(opt) {
    if (isDragging) {
      var e = opt.e;
      var vpt = fabricCanvas.viewportTransform;
      vpt[4] += e.clientX - lastPosX;
      vpt[5] += e.clientY - lastPosY;
      fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
      lastPosX = e.clientX;
      lastPosY = e.clientY;
      fabricCanvas.setCursor('grabbing');
    }
  });

  fabricCanvas.on('mouse:up', function(opt) {
    if (isDragging) {
      fabricCanvas.setViewportTransform(fabricCanvas.viewportTransform);
      isDragging = false;
      fabricCanvas.selection = true;
      fabricCanvas.setCursor('default');
    }
  });

  // Disable context menu on canvas to allow right-click panning
  fabricCanvas.wrapperEl.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
  });

  // Keyboard shortcuts
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
      switch(e.key.toLowerCase()) {
        case 'z':
          if (e.shiftKey) {
            // Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z)
            e.preventDefault();
            // Fabric.js doesn't have built-in undo/redo, you'd need to implement this
            console.log('Redo action');
          } else {
            // Undo (Ctrl+Z)
            e.preventDefault();
            console.log('Undo action');
          }
          break;
        case 'c':
          // Copy (Ctrl+C)
          e.preventDefault();
          copySelectedObject();
          break;
        case 'v':
          // Paste (Ctrl+V)
          e.preventDefault();
          pasteObject();
          break;
        case 'a':
          // Select all (Ctrl+A)
          e.preventDefault();
          selectAllObjects();
          break;
        case '=':
        case '+':
          // Zoom in
          e.preventDefault();
          zoomIn();
          break;
        case '-':
          // Zoom out
          e.preventDefault();
          zoomOut();
          break;
        case '0':
          // Reset zoom
          e.preventDefault();
          resetZoom();
          break;
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') {
      // Delete selected objects
      deleteSelectedObjects();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      // Deselect all
      fabricCanvas.discardActiveObject();
      fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
      if (isFileMenuOpen) {
        closeSlidingFileMenu();
      }
    }
  });

  return fabricCanvas;
}

// Fabric.js utility functions
let copiedObject = null;

function copySelectedObject() {
  const activeObject = fabricCanvas.getActiveObject();
  if (activeObject) {
    activeObject.clone(function(cloned) {
      copiedObject = cloned;
    });
  }
}

function pasteObject() {
  if (copiedObject) {
    copiedObject.clone(function(clonedObj) {
      fabricCanvas.discardActiveObject();
      clonedObj.set({
        left: clonedObj.left + 10,
        top: clonedObj.top + 10,
        evented: true,
      });
      if (clonedObj.type === 'activeSelection') {
        clonedObj.canvas = fabricCanvas;
        clonedObj.forEachObject(function(obj) {
          fabricCanvas.add(obj);
        });
        clonedObj.setCoords();
      } else {
        fabricCanvas.add(clonedObj);
      }
      fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(clonedObj);
      fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
    });
  }
}

function selectAllObjects() {
  const allObjects = fabricCanvas.getObjects();
  if (allObjects.length > 0) {
    const selection = new fabric.ActiveSelection(allObjects, {
      canvas: fabricCanvas,
    });
    fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(selection);
    fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
  }
}

function deleteSelectedObjects() {
  const activeObjects = fabricCanvas.getActiveObjects();
  if (activeObjects.length > 0) {
    fabricCanvas.discardActiveObject();
    activeObjects.forEach(obj => {
      fabricCanvas.remove(obj);
    });
    fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
  }
}

function zoomIn() {
  const zoom = fabricCanvas.getZoom();
  fabricCanvas.setZoom(Math.min(zoom * 1.1, 20));
}

function zoomOut() {
  const zoom = fabricCanvas.getZoom();
  fabricCanvas.setZoom(Math.max(zoom * 0.9, 0.01));
}

function resetZoom() {
  fabricCanvas.setViewportTransform([1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]);
  fabricCanvas.setZoom(1);
}

function resizeCanvas() {
  const container = document.getElementById('fabric-canvas-container');
  fabricCanvas.setDimensions({
    width: container.clientWidth,
    height: container.clientHeight
  });
}

// File menu functions
function toggleSlidingFileMenu() {
  const menu = document.getElementById('file-sliding-menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('file-menu-overlay');
  
  if (isFileMenuOpen) {
    closeSlidingFileMenu();
  } else {
    openSlidingFileMenu();
  }
}

function openSlidingFileMenu() {
  const menu = document.getElementById('file-sliding-menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('file-menu-overlay');
  
  menu.classList.add('open');
  overlay.classList.add('active');
  isFileMenuOpen = true;
}

function closeSlidingFileMenu() {
  const menu = document.getElementById('file-sliding-menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('file-menu-overlay');
  
  menu.classList.remove('open');
  overlay.classList.remove('active');
  isFileMenuOpen = false;
}

// Page management functions
function renderPageButtons() {
  const container = document.getElementById('page-buttons');
  container.innerHTML = '';
  
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    const button = document.createElement('div');
    button.className = 'page-button';
    button.textContent = i;
    button.onclick = () => switchToPage(i);
    
    if (i === currentPage) {
      button.classList.add('selected');
    }
    
    container.appendChild(button);
  }
}

function switchToPage(pageNum) {
  if (pageNum >= 1 && pageNum <= totalPages) {
    // Save current page state
    if (fabricCanvas) {
      pages[currentPage].objects = fabricCanvas.toJSON();
    }
    
    currentPage = pageNum;
    updatePageLabel();
    renderPageButtons();
    
    // Load new page state
    if (fabricCanvas && pages[currentPage]) {
      fabricCanvas.loadFromJSON(pages[currentPage].objects || { objects: [] }, function() {
        fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
      });
    }
  }
}

function addNewPage() {
  totalPages++;
  pages[totalPages] = { objects: [] };
  switchToPage(totalPages);
}

function deletePage(pageNum) {
  if (totalPages <= 1) return; // Can't delete the last page
  
  delete pages[pageNum];
  
  // Renumber pages
  const newPages = {};
  let newPageNum = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    if (i !== pageNum && pages[i]) {
      newPages[newPageNum] = pages[i];
      newPageNum++;
    }
  }
  
  pages = newPages;
  totalPages--;
  
  if (currentPage >= pageNum && currentPage > 1) {
    currentPage--;
  }
  
  renderPageButtons();
  updatePageLabel();
  
  // Load current page
  if (fabricCanvas && pages[currentPage]) {
    fabricCanvas.loadFromJSON(pages[currentPage].objects || { objects: [] }, function() {
      fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
    });
  }
}

function updatePageLabel() {
  document.getElementById('page-label').textContent = `PAGE ${currentPage}`;
}

// Fabric.js implementation functions
function addBackground() {
  const input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file';
  input.accept = 'image/*';
  input.onchange = function(e) {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(event) {
        fabric.Image.fromURL(event.target.result, function(img) {
          // Scale image to fit canvas as background
          const canvasWidth = fabricCanvas.getWidth();
          const canvasHeight = fabricCanvas.getHeight();
          const imgWidth = img.width;
          const imgHeight = img.height;
          
          const scaleX = canvasWidth / imgWidth;
          const scaleY = canvasHeight / imgHeight;
          const scale = Math.max(scaleX, scaleY);
          
          img.set({
            scaleX: scale,
            scaleY: scale,
            left: canvasWidth / 2,
            top: canvasHeight / 2,
            originX: 'center',
            originY: 'center',
            selectable: false,
            evented: false
          });
          
          fabricCanvas.setBackgroundImage(img, fabricCanvas.renderAll.bind(fabricCanvas));
        });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };
  input.click();
}

function addImage() {
  const input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file';
  input.accept = 'image/*';
  input.onchange = function(e) {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(event) {
        fabric.Image.fromURL(event.target.result, function(img) {
          img.set({
            left: 100,
            top: 100,
            scaleX: 0.5,
            scaleY: 0.5
          });
          fabricCanvas.add(img);
          fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(img);
          fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
        });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };
  input.click();
}

function showTextboxPopup() {
  const text = prompt('Enter text:');
  if (text) {
    const textObj = new fabric.Text(text, {
      left: 100,
      top: 100,
      fontFamily: 'Arial',
      fontSize: 20,
      fill: '#000000'
    });
    fabricCanvas.add(textObj);
    fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(textObj);
    fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
  }
}

function showButtonPopup() {
  // Add a rectangle that looks like a button
  const button = new fabric.Rect({
    left: 100,
    top: 100,
    width: 120,
    height: 40,
    fill: '#667eea',
    stroke: '#4a5568',
    strokeWidth: 2,
    rx: 8,
    ry: 8
  });
  
  const buttonText = new fabric.Text('Button', {
    left: 160,
    top: 120,
    fontFamily: 'Arial',
    fontSize: 14,
    fill: '#ffffff',
    originX: 'center',
    originY: 'center'
  });
  
  const group = new fabric.Group([button, buttonText], {
    left: 100,
    top: 100
  });
  
  fabricCanvas.add(group);
  fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(group);
  fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
}

// File operations
function saveAs() {
  const json = JSON.stringify({
    pages: pages,
    currentPage: currentPage,
    totalPages: totalPages,
    currentCanvas: fabricCanvas.toJSON()
  });
  
  const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'fabric-project.json';
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function saveFile() {
  // Save current canvas state to current page
  if (fabricCanvas) {
    pages[currentPage].objects = fabricCanvas.toJSON();
  }
  console.log('Project saved to memory');
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function uploadFile() {
  const input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file';
  input.accept = '.json';
  input.onchange = function(e) {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(event) {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(event.target.result);
          pages = data.pages || { 1: { objects: [] } };
          currentPage = data.currentPage || 1;
          totalPages = data.totalPages || 1;
          
          if (data.currentCanvas && fabricCanvas) {
            fabricCanvas.loadFromJSON(data.currentCanvas, function() {
              fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
            });
          }
          
          renderPageButtons();
          updatePageLabel();
        } catch (error) {
          alert('Error loading file: ' + error.message);
        }
      };
      reader.readAsText(file);
    }
  };
  input.click();
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function openFile() {
  uploadFile(); // Same as upload for now
}

function shareFile() {
  if (navigator.share && fabricCanvas) {
    const dataURL = fabricCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    fetch(dataURL)
      .then(res => res.blob())
      .then(blob => {
        const file = new File([blob], 'canvas-export.png', { type: 'image/png' });
        navigator.share({
          files: [file],
          title: 'My Fabric Canvas'
        });
      });
  } else {
    alert('Sharing not supported on this browser');
  }
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function ExportFile() {
  if (fabricCanvas) {
    const dataURL = fabricCanvas.toDataURL({
      format: 'png',
      quality: 1.0,
      multiplier: 2
    });
    
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.download = 'canvas-export.png';
    link.href = dataURL;
    link.click();
  }
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function ImportFile() {
  uploadFile(); // Same as upload for now
}

function viewCode() {
  if (fabricCanvas) {
    const json = JSON.stringify(fabricCanvas.toJSON(), null, 2);
    const popup = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
    popup.document.write(`
      <html>
        <head><title>Canvas JSON</title></head>
        <body>
          <h3>Fabric.js Canvas JSON:</h3>
          <pre style="white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: monospace;">${json}</pre>
        </body>
      </html>
    `);
  }
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function ToolsFile() {
  // Add some basic shapes
  const shapes = [
    () => {
      const rect = new fabric.Rect({
        left: 100, top: 100, width: 100, height: 100,
        fill: '#667eea', stroke: '#4a5568', strokeWidth: 2
      });
      fabricCanvas.add(rect);
    },
    () => {
      const circle = new fabric.Circle({
        left: 100, top: 100, radius: 50,
        fill: '#764ba2', stroke: '#4a5568', strokeWidth: 2
      });
      fabricCanvas.add(circle);
    },
    () => {
      const triangle = new fabric.Triangle({
        left: 100, top: 100, width: 100, height: 100,
        fill: '#e74c3c', stroke: '#4a5568', strokeWidth: 2
      });
      fabricCanvas.add(triangle);
    }
  ];
  
  const shapeIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * shapes.length);
  shapes[shapeIndex]();
  fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
  
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function openHelpPopup() {
  alert(`Fabric.js Canvas Controls:
  
• Mouse wheel: Zoom in/out
• Middle click + drag: Pan canvas
• Right click + drag: Pan canvas (on empty space)
• Ctrl+Z: Undo (not implemented)
• Ctrl+Shift+Z: Redo (not implemented)
• Ctrl+C: Copy selected object
• Ctrl+V: Paste object
• Ctrl+A: Select all objects
• Delete/Backspace: Delete selected objects
• Ctrl + Plus: Zoom in
• Ctrl + Minus: Zoom out
• Ctrl + 0: Reset zoom
• Escape: Deselect all objects`);
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function previewGame() {
  inPreviewMode = !inPreviewMode;
  if (inPreviewMode) {
    document.body.classList.add('preview-fullscreen');
    fabricCanvas.selection = false;
    fabricCanvas.forEachObject(obj => {
      obj.selectable = false;
      obj.evented = false;
    });
  } else {
    document.body.classList.remove('preview-fullscreen');
    fabricCanvas.selection = true;
    fabricCanvas.forEachObject(obj => {
      obj.selectable = true;
      obj.evented = true;
    });
  }
  fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}
